newsitem.title: USA: U.S. economy poised for long-run growth - Stiglitz.
newsitem.headline: U.S. economy poised for long-run growth - Stiglitz.

text.p: White House economic adviser Joseph Stiglitz said Friday that the latest economic data show the U.S. economy is on track for long-term growth with low inflation.

"Today's employment release provides further evidence that the economy is on the right track -- with strong job growth, low unemployment, and subdued inflationary pressures," Stiglitz told reporters in a briefing.
Stiglitz said the October labor report showing unemployment remaining steady at 5.2 percent shows that the United States is enjoying "a vibrant economy poised for sustained long-run growth."
He noted that inflation is running at a three percent annual rate and that business equipment investment is up sharply, growing at a robust 19 percent annual rate in the last quarter.
